parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value, which must be globally unique. The token can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: OrgId
parameters.description: The organization ID. This parameter is required only for Codeup.

parameters.name: RepoFullName
parameters.description: The full name of the repository.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The repository ID. This parameter is required only for Codeup.
